verdict.rationale: cubic's own docs describe the full in-PR flow: a 'Fix with cubic' button and one-click targeted fixes on review findings, fixes generated and pushed to the PR branch, fixes triggered from PR comments, an optional auto-fix for every review, and coding agents that use your configured provider. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that fixes are applied correctly to the PR branch.

support.subject: As a developer, I turn a review finding into an applied fix — a committed patch or an agent-generated follow-up — without leaving the PR

citations.quote: cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
When the AI spots a problem, you can click the **Fix with cubic** button
Request a targeted fix with one click, or turn on auto-fix to have cubic fix the issues from every review of a pull request.
Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
Coding agents: Generate fixes when requested, using your configured provider
